title: ECU Internal Fault
shortDescription: Body control module internal failure detected.
fullDescription: The BCM has detected an internal hardware or memory fault. Many body functions including lighting and locks may be inoperative.
safetyImpact: Affected lighting or convenience function may compromise visibility or comfort.

fixSteps.title: Verify symptom
fixSteps.instruction: Operate the affected circuit and confirm the failure mode (no operation, intermittent, etc.).

fixSteps.title: Check fuse and bulb
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the fuse for the affected circuit and replace any burnt bulbs.

fixSteps.title: Test wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to confirm power and ground at the affected component connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the failed lamp assembly, motor, or actuator. Clear codes with a scan tool.

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with code B1000?
faq.a: It depends on severity. Driving with reduced safety system function or major engine faults is not recommended; have it diagnosed promptly.

faq.q: Will B1000 clear itself?
faq.a: Some codes self-clear after several successful drive cycles once the underlying issue is fixed. Others require a scan tool to clear.

faq.q: How much does it cost to fix B1000?
faq.a: Costs vary by component and labor rate. See the estimated cost ranges above for typical DIY and professional repair pricing.
